facts.claim: Mass timber buildings are built faster than steel or concrete ones.
facts.quote: MT buildings on average save 20-25% in time

facts.claim: They perform well in earthquakes.
facts.quote: MT built buildings perform very well in seismic events

facts.claim: Half-timbered building goes back to Roman times in Herculaneum.
facts.quote: The most ancient known half-timbered building is called the House of opus craticum.

facts.claim: Mjostarnet (Norway, 2019) was the world's tallest wooden building when finished.
facts.quote: officially the world's tallest wooden building

facts.claim: The Yingxian pagoda (1056) is the oldest fully wooden pagoda in China.
facts.quote: the oldest existent fully wooden pagoda still standing in China

facts.claim: Ise Grand Shrine is traditionally rebuilt every 20 years in cypress.
facts.quote: has been traditionally rebuilt every 20 years

facts.claim: Metropol Parasol is marketed as the world's largest wooden structure.
facts.quote: marketed as the world's largest wooden structure

facts.claim: A tensile structure carries only tension, no compression or bending.
facts.quote: a construction of elements carrying only tension and no compression or bending

facts.claim: It is not the same as tensegrity.
facts.quote: The term tensile should not be confused with tensegrity

facts.claim: Vladimir Shukhov was an early pioneer of the calculations.
facts.quote: one of the first to develop practical calculations of stresses and deformations of tensile structures

facts.claim: Frei Otto championed the idea; his first use was the West German pavilion at Expo 67.
facts.quote: whose first use of the idea was in the construction of the West German pavilion at Expo 67

facts.claim: Otto then used it for the Munich Olympic Stadium roof (1972).
facts.quote: Otto next used the idea for the roof of the Olympic Stadium.

facts.claim: Such structures are mostly roofs because they span long distances economically.
facts.quote: most often used as a roof, as they can economically and attractively span large distances

facts.claim: Common fabrics are PTFE-coated fibreglass and PVC-coated polyester.
facts.quote: Common materials for doubly curved fabric structures are PTFE-coated fiberglass and PVC-coated polyester

facts.claim: Some use ETFE film as single layers or cushions.
facts.quote: Other structures make use of ETFE film, either as single layer or in cushion form

facts.claim: Pretensioning keeps flexible elements stiff under load.
facts.quote: to ensure that the normally very flexible structural elements remain stiff under all possible loads

facts.claim: Otto founded the Institute for Lightweight Structures in Stuttgart in 1964.
facts.quote: Otto founded the Institute for Lightweight Structures
